name: Office Setup Variant 5
task:
Please complete the following four-stage office task.

=== Stage 1: Supply Gathering ===
You need to set up 3 new employee workstations. Each: printed nameplate, welcome packet (5 pages stapled), desk supplies (pen, notebook, sticky notes). Supplies: printer with 50 sheets, 3 sets of supplies, stapler.

=== Stage 2: Document Preparation ===
Print and organize the documents.

=== Stage 3: Assembly ===
Bind and compile the documents.

=== Stage 4: Cleanup ===
Dispose of waste and organize workspace.
